Hi there floor staff,
Thanks for a hardworking session; the arrivals lead discussed a few words on lounge layout

I am sending a brief internal note for the Companion Animal Travel Desk so the team record stays clear and useful. Please continue to keep the welcome area calm and uncluttered, and remember that respectful wording at the counter helps travelers feel that their pets are in careful hands. When an animal arrives after a disruption, the cabin team and the welcome team should pass along observations in plain language, with the records aide noting the details in the same steady order used across our desk.

For any traveler asking about follow-up after a missed connection, <<FACT F116>> Please place the marker exactly as received in the file and do not add extra commentary around it. If a crate is reported missing, <<FACT F112>> and the same careful handling applies there as well. Our role is to keep communication prompt, accurate, and courteous, while making sure no one has to repeat the same story more than necessary.

Marcus Costa and Mei Lee can be used as reference travelers in the log if their records are already open, and Willow may be mentioned only where a pet tag or care note already supports it. The main point for the floor is to keep the desk visible, the language steady, and the handoff between teams respectful. Small adjustments in layout and wording can make a difficult arrival feel more orderly for both passengers and animals.

Thank you for keeping the area ready and the notes complete.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
